text_block_list.text: The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival. Similar to a sports day, it is a major event where guests from outside the academy are welcomed, and Umamusume entertain them with a variety of fun activities—
The night before the event...

As for me...
I was standing in the cafeteria's spacious kitchen,
having submitted an application to use it in advance.
Piled high upon the workbench in front of us were the ingredients for the cooking we were about to begin.
I reviewed the compiled work process on the tablet propped up on the stand. It was a dizzying amount of work, but—
choice_data_list: No, let's give it our all! For Messiah's sake, too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, we had a class meeting today
to decide on the events for the Fan Appreciation Festival, but...”
At the Fan Appreciation Festival, every Umamusume is required to participate in at least one event.

Events can be organized not just by class, but also by team, volunteer groups, or even individuals—
however, Air Messiah is currently busy with racing.

She hadn't proposed any events herself, and was slated
to participate in one of the events presented by the academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When we polled the class for their desired events to compete in,
the results ended up quite skewed.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We decided to draw lots, but as a result,
the task I was assigned to was—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's an event where you participate
as a pair with your trainer, but the details are...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well... 'It's a time-attack competition to see who can finish eating 10kg of their Trainer's home cooking.'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...It really is asking too much, isn't it? Having you prepare 10kg worth of food by the day of the event..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'll find a way to turn it down.
I can't place such a burden on you, Trainer.
If it's an unpopular event, surely there are still open spots—
I honestly recoiled in shock a moment ago... but I chide myself, thinking I should really consider this carefully.

Normally, all one could do in the end was pray and watch over her...
To be able to contribute directly to her victory like this—isn't this truly a precious opportunity?

Countless fans literally gather at the Thanksgiving Festival.
If there's even a little I can do to help Air Messiah seize glory there—!
choice_data_list: I'll... I'll do my best! Let's enter the competition!
I'll... do my best! Let's enter the competition!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Goodness... Are you sure it's alright?
choice_data_list: Ah, of course, it depends on what you want though!
Ah, of course, it depends on what you desire though!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, as for that... um, I'm sorry.
To be completely honest—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Getting to eat so much
of your home cooking, Trainer... Well...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I caught myself thinking it was quite a nice perk.
Hehe, I'm sorry.

And so, right now...
I'm intensely whipping up dish after dish!

The most crucial factor in this competition is
'what to make'... in other words, 'menu selection.'
This will heavily sway the outcome.
"You see, perhaps to ease the burden of preparation, the rule is to prepare 'only one single dish, weighing 10kg.'"

Will you prepare your trainee's favorite food?
Or tailor the menu around her being a fast eater?
While approaches may vary—
choice_data_list: (The dish I'm going to prepare is...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Bonds Speed-Eating Championship is finally about to begin!
Which pair will claim the glorious victory~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, here I go!! Gonna scarf it down in no time!
Watch me, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, of course my trainer and I are gonna win!!
Go ahead, bring on 10 kg, or even 100 kg!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hoh. Looks like we'll be up against quite a fired-up bunch.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I mean, what kind of event is that guy even competing in...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah seems slightly behind in terms of fighting spirit!
Now then, let's have the trainers bring out
the dishes right away~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ha. She's always giving the cold shoulder like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Either way, sheer spirit alone won't decide the outcome.
Now then, let's see what that one's Trainer
has prepared—

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"What I've prepared is—
the 'Super Special Party Cake'!!"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO, look at that flashy presentation!!
Man~ just looking at this gets me so pumped, pal!!
I feel like I could eat this foreverrr!!

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer A
text_block_list.text: My girl is... simple and straightforward, as you can see! In that case, I'll go with something clear-cut—sweets that'll boost her motivation!!

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so predictable. Here is what I have prepared—
the "Variety Hot Dog"!!

text_block_list.name: Assigned Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Considering the rules, my course of action was obvious.
While staying within the definition of a 'hot dog',
I varied the flavors as much as humanly possible!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A scheme to keep the tastebuds entertained, huh!
Ha, I can always count on you, partner!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Things are really heating up now!
And for our finale, Air Messiah's Trainer!
Please present your dish!!"

The dish that was somehow finished last night.
Holding the large pot containing it, I step forward.
Yes, what I made was—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, huh? I-Is that all?
Like... no big finishing stunt
to wrap things up or anything...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...What an intense atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean... well, rather than fancy-ass sweets,
it was regular old Japanese food, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just as the commentary mentioned, unlike the other participants, we can't see any distinct countermeasures from them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? No, but perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm...! Now that the somewhat pl—er, 
simple final dish is served! 
Let's get right into—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The ‘Bonds of Speed-Eating Championship’ has begun!
Time to dig iiiiiin!!"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOORYAAAAAH IT'S SO SWEEET!!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Hmph! Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Trainer...! This nikujaga—)

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! *urgh*... So sweet...!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hngh...! Ngggh...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoaaa!? What an unexpected twist!
A while after the start, as the other two runners
are gradually starting to struggle—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Only Air Messiah isn't slowing down!!
Calmly and steadily, she continues eating away!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...The hell?
You don't even have that big of an appetite.
...There's gotta be a trick to this, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...!
It's hard to see from a distance, but that nikujaga—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It uses chicken!
Compared to beef or pork, it has significantly less fat, so it won't sit heavy on your stomach...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (—That's not all.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Add just enough vinegar to keep it light and refreshing without ruining the flavor...
and dice the root vegetables small enough so they don't break apart while simmering...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(This nikujaga...
is overflowing with the steady, thoughtful ideas he put together
to help me seize victory!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(This nikujaga...
is overflowing with the steady, thoughtful ideas she put together
to help me seize victory!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew...—Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I can still eat plenty more!
—Seconds, please!

Air Messiah is eating at a steady pace!
However, the other contestants are fiercely pursuing her...!
The outcome of this intense head-to-head battle is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry, Trainer.
I fell... one step short.
choice_data_list: No, you really gave it your all...!
No, you really did your best...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No... no, truly.
...I'm so, so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um... This might be very impolite, or rather,
a totally selfish request, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Sometime again in the future...
would you make today's nikujaga for me again?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "And when that time came, after savoring every single bite thoroughly..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please let me share my thoughts on how it tasted.
...Because it truly, genuinely, was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To make up for not being able to
proudly make it known before everyone today—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Humble though I may be,
I will do my very best to express everything in words.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable, the winners are the Air Messiah pair~~~!!
With an unexpected 'Nikujaga,'
they raced all the way to victory!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Hehe. Congratulations to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Come now, today of all days, you are not
one to stand on the sidelines giving praise.
Please, step right this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And then... um, Mr. Commentator.
Would it be alright if I borrowed the microphone for just a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh!? A victory performance, is it?!
Please, by all means, go right ahead!

And Air Messiah spoke crisply and clearly,
explaining the special touches put into the nikujaga earlier
and just how easy it had been to eat.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, Trainer <username>,
was it? You've really thought this through~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right! Having someone like that supporting her
must be really reassuring for that Air Messiah girl~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Once again, thank you for your hard work,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry about earlier,
dragging you out so suddenly."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm sorry. But—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When Valentine's Day came and I saw so many people
beginning to recognize your worth...
it made me feel truly, genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I... am probably the one who watches your
unceasing efforts from the closest vantage point right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Seeing all that solid, steady effort finally blossom into fruition is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'm truly... so happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
So... hehe.
I ended up showing off again today.
Saying things like, 'Isn't this person amazing?'

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't this person amazing?
More than anyone, more than anyone else...
they're such a hard worker," I'd say.
